classification.vuln_type: assert-abort (out-of-range TEID used as array index)

trigger.message: PFCP Session Establishment Request with PFCPSEReqFlags.RESTI=1 and F-TEID.TEID = 0 OR > pool size (max_ue*4*16)
trigger.ie_path: Create PDR > PDI > F-TEID > teid + top-level PFCPSEReqFlags
trigger.field: F-TEID.teid value. Under Restoration Indication, ogs_pfcp_pdr_swap_teid uses the attacker-supplied TEID directly as a pool array index, then asserts that it lies in (0, pool.size]. Sending TEID=0 or TEID>pool.size trips the assertion. PB1 'Invalid Value' (ID outside valid range, used directly as lookup key).
trigger.precondition: PFCP association established (the PoC sends an Association Setup Request first; the Session Establishment Request that follows trips the assertion).

ground_truth.crash_type: reachable assertion: `pdr->f_teid.teid > 0 && pdr->f_teid.teid <= ogs_pfcp_pdr_teid_pool.size' failed -> abort (core dumped)
